questions.question: Under the International Law Commission's Articles on Responsibility of States for Internationally Wrongful Acts (ARSIWA), as affirmed by the International Court of Justice in the Genocide (Bosnia v. Serbia) case, what legal standard is required to attribute the conduct of a private paramilitary group to a State under Article 8?
options: The State exercised overall control over the group's general organizational and military strategy.
The State exercised effective control over the specific operations in which the alleged breaches occurred.
The State provided continuous financial, logistical, and military assistance to the group.
The paramilitary group operated within the territorial boundaries of the State with its passive consent.

questions.question: Under Article 7 of the 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), which criterion must a coastal State fulfill when drawing straight baselines for measuring the breadth of the territorial sea?
options: The drawing of straight baselines must not depart to any appreciable extent from the general direction of the coast.
Straight baselines may only be drawn from low-tide elevations that have lighthouses or permanent installations.
The sea areas lying within straight baselines are automatically classified as archipelagic waters rather than internal waters.
The coastal State must receive prior authorization from the International Maritime Organization.

questions.question: Under customary international law, which requirement must a State satisfy to successfully establish itself as a 'persistent objector' to an emerging rule of customary law?
options: It must register a formal objection with the UN General Assembly within one year after the rule crystallizes.
It must show that the customary rule conflicts with its municipal constitutional law.
It must clearly, openly, and consistently object to the rule during its formation and maintain that objection continuously.
It must obtain a advisory opinion from the International Court of Justice endorsing its objection.

questions.question: Under Article 31 of the 1961 Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, a diplomatic agent enjoys immunity from the civil and administrative jurisdiction of the receiving State. Which of the following is an explicit exception to this immunity?
options: A lawsuit arising from a motor vehicle accident involving an official embassy vehicle.
A claim for breach of contract entered into by the diplomat on behalf of the sending State for mission supplies.
A proceeding concerning official acts performed by the diplomat within the scope of their diplomatic duties.
An action relating to any professional or commercial activity exercised by the diplomatic agent in the receiving State outside their official functions.

questions.question: In international investment law, how do investment tribunals typically distinguish a non-compensable legitimate regulatory measure (police powers) from an indirect expropriation requiring compensation?
options: Any state measure that reduces the foreign investor's net revenues by more than 30% is automatically deemed an indirect expropriation.
Bona fide, non-discriminatory regulatory measures adopted for a public purpose and proportionate to their aim generally do not constitute indirect expropriation.
An indirect expropriation occurs only if the host State physically seizes the legal title to the investment's shares.
Measures taken to protect public health or environmental safety are strictly prohibited from being reviewed for expropriation.
